# orchestra_incident_settings (Resource)

The workspace's incident settings: whether incidents are raised, which failures can raise one, and the alert budget.

There is one set per workspace, so declare this resource once. An attribute left unset keeps its current value. Destroying the resource only removes it from state; the settings stay as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One per workspace. Settings left out keep their current value.
resource "orchestra_incident_settings" "this" {
  incidents_enabled       = true
  auto_resolve_on_success = true

  # Only failures in the production environment raise incidents.
  environment_ids = ["11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"]

  # At most five alerts per destination per incident each day.
  max_alerts_per_incident     = 5
  alert_budget_refill_cadence = "daily"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alert_budget_refill_cadence` (String) How often the alert budget resets: `daily`, `weekly` or `never`. With `never` the budget is spent once per incident.
- `auto_diagnose_incidents` (Boolean) Have Orchestra's diagnoser investigate incidents as they open and grow.
- `auto_resolve_on_success` (Boolean) Resolve an open incident once everything it covers has succeeded again.
- `environment_ids` (Set of String) Only failures from these environments open or join an incident. Empty means every environment.
- `group_warning_with_failed` (Boolean) Group warnings into the same incidents as failures.
- `incidents_enabled` (Boolean) Raise incidents. Off, failures still alert but are not grouped into incidents.
- `max_alerts_per_incident` (Number) The alert budget: live alerts sent to each destination per incident, from 1 to 50, before further updates are rolled into one notice.
- `require_alert_configured` (Boolean) Only failures from pipelines with alerting configured can raise an incident.
- `warnings_enabled` (Boolean) Let warnings open and join incidents.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always incident_settings: a workspace has one set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A workspace has one set of incident settings, imported by this fixed ID.
terraform import orchestra_incident_settings.this incident_settings
```
